text: Owner decision 2026-09-29: historical commits that fail the DCO sign-off gate when main and v1-development histories are joined (710: 576 GitHub merge commits, 134 owner commits, 67 with a Claude co-author) are attested as signed off by the owner via .github/dco-historical-attestations.json.
